name: 48244-longprefillspec-qwen3-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 256 requests / 1800 s safety, with 10% warmup and 10% cooldown declared. At 64 streams neither declared phase resolves to a real window, so effectively all 256 requests are scored, including the opening wave.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 16384 tokens and output exactly 1 (max_tokens=1, ignore_eos=True), greedy (temperature 0.0), seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis service scoring full-length reports with an 8B model, 64 concurrent 16k-token requests on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit a49d37c6b902036385fcfd87c9ed40320ac06490
# (v0.23.1rc0-1430-ga49d37c6b9). Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable).
#
# HAZARD: the runtime reader is a FLAT `key: value` line reader that skips indented lines, so
# `speculative-config` MUST stay a single-line JSON flow mapping. A block mapping is silently
# dropped and the engine then starts with no drafter, at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1}
max-model-len: 20480
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 64
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85

# Off: every prompt is 16384 unique synthetic tokens, and any head served out of cache instead would
# stop the request being the one scenario.json declares.
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true
dtype: bfloat16
